keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Frank Anguissa (Napoli).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Douglas Luiz (Juventus) is shown the yellow card.
Jhon Lucumí (Juventus) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Luca Marianucci (Napoli) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Juventus. Federico Gatti replaces Weston McKennie.
Substitution, Napoli. Amir Rrahmani replaces Giovanni Di Lorenzo.
Substitution, Napoli. Billy Gilmour replaces Kevin De Bruyne.
